Duel Terminal Normal Parallel Rare.name: Elemental HERO Neos Alius
Duel Terminal Normal Parallel Rare.desc:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the GY. While this card is a Normal Monster on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.
● This card's name becomes "Elemental HERO Neos" while on the field.

Duel Terminal Rare Parallel Rare.name: Musto, Oracle of Gusto
Duel Terminal Rare Parallel Rare.desc: Once per turn: You can target 1 "Gusto" monster in your Graveyard and 1 face-up monster on the field; shuffle the first target into the Deck, and if you do, negate the second target's effects until the End Phase.
